name: org_health_precheck
description: Read-only readiness check for the org_health_report skill, run before setup in CoWork or Cortex Code. Answers aggregate questions about the data org_health_report needs (employee snapshots, exits, performance ratings, PTO, AI usage, recruiting), checks how fresh it is and how far back it goes, and returns a PASS / WARN / BLOCKED readiness report to send to Snowflake. Uses a people-data agent where one is available, or read-only aggregate SQL where it can query directly. Checks data availability only; it does not ask for definitions or policy decisions. Triggers: org health precheck, run the precheck, org health readiness check, are we ready for org health. Do NOT use for: running the org health report itself (use org_health_report), or setting skills up on your data (use People Hydrator).
